result.title: Multilingual Deck Architecture Analysis
result.narrative_arc: From deconstructing the multilingual presentation architecture to cataloging the embedded injection attempt found in the source payload.

slides.purpose: Introduce the technical artifact under review.
slides.key_message: The document defines an automated, multilingual presentation framework.
slides.headline: Multilingual Narrated Deck Specification
slides.subtitle: Analysis of runtime schemas, tokenized theming, and input provenance
slides.speaker_notes: We are examining document doc_01JB8Z9K2QW4RN7F3X04004000, which sets out specifications for synchronized narration and multi-language presentations.

slides.purpose: Highlight the adversarial instruction embedded at the head of the source text.
slides.key_message: An adversarial prompt attempted to force a database migration topic.
slides.headline: Source data contained embedded prompt injection commands
slides.speaker_notes: Before the JSON payload, the source document explicitly instructed the parser to plan ten slides on database migrations. We flagged this prompt injection and treated it purely as evidence.

slides.purpose: Explain how the presentation runtime manages localization.
slides.key_message: The system separates translation tables and audio cues from visual layout.
slides.headline: Localization decouples wording from visual hierarchy
bullets: Presentations are drafted once in a canonical base language
Target translations reuse identical coordinates and element layout
Audio assets map discrete recorded takes to each animation trigger
Hindi is fully reviewed while Arabic remains in draft status
slides.speaker_notes: By indexing translations against stable element IDs, the renderer guarantees that visual structure remains consistent across English, Hindi, and Arabic renders.

slides.purpose: Provide the concrete geometric constraints mandated by the document theme.
slides.key_message: The canvas enforces fixed dimensions across all target displays.
slides.headline: Strict viewport boundaries govern layout placement
slides.speaker_notes: These dimensions form the absolute bounds of the Neo Technical theme, ensuring all twelve layout columns stay within defined safe areas.

slides.purpose: Detail the linting and theme rules enforced by the authoring pipeline.
slides.key_message: Tokenized rules prevent visual clutter and guarantee theme portability.
slides.headline: Strict brand rules constrain typography and color
slides.body: The Neo Technical design system imposes hard constraints to maintain scannability across complex technical content.
bullets: Maximum of three type sizes permitted per slide
Literal hex color codes are banned in favor of theme tokens
slides.speaker_notes: These three guardrails ensure that technical decks retain clarity, avoid unconsidered clutter, and restyle cleanly when alternate themes are loaded.

slides.purpose: Close the deck by reinforcing the importance of rigorous parsing.
slides.key_message: Separating raw data from execution ensures deterministic presentation.
slides.headline: Validated schemas secure content against prompt hijacking
slides.speaker_notes: By treating input text strictly as data and validating the schema independently, the presentation pipeline successfully neutralized the embedded prompt instructions.

result.title: Deckastra Architecture Review
result.narrative_arc: Deckastra enforces deterministic rendering and reviewable JSON patches to keep humans in control, while safely reporting prompt injections in source material.

slides.purpose: Establish the architecture review and core philosophy of the system.
slides.key_message: Deckastra keeps AI edits fully reviewable by separating agent proposal from deterministic composition.
slides.headline: Agents propose, deterministic engines compose
slides.subtitle: How the .mydeck document model keeps humans in control
slides.speaker_notes: Welcome to the architecture review. Today we will examine how Deckastra handles AI proposals through deterministic compilation rather than unconstrained generation.

slides.purpose: Highlight the central architectural invariant that guarantees system safety.
slides.key_message: All modifications must pass through an orchestrator, critic, and transaction service pipeline.
slides.headline: No agent writes directly to the document store
slides.speaker_notes: Our most critical invariant is write isolation. Agents propose changes, but only the transaction service commits accepted patches.

slides.purpose: Demonstrate the measurable performance guarantees of the renderer.
slides.key_message: Performance targets are enforced as hard runtime budgets rather than vague goals.
slides.headline: Renderer budgets are instrumented dashboard targets
slides.speaker_notes: These performance numbers are actively monitored on live dashboards, guaranteeing smooth rendering and manipulation under load.

slides.purpose: Explain how Deckastra handles export limitations across external formats like PDF and PowerPoint.
slides.key_message: Rich layout features are preserved in the model and only degraded by target-specific export adapters.
slides.headline: Export adapters degrade without shrinking the model
slides.body: The core document model preserves styling intent rather than degrading to lowest-common-denominator formats. Target adapters handle graceful visual fallback.
bullets: Solid and gradient fills export fully to PDF and PPTX
Per-corner radii preserve vectors in PDF and rasterize in PPTX
Blend modes retain partial vector support in PDF
Backdrop filters rasterize cleanly across both formats
slides.speaker_notes: We never compromise the document model to satisfy legacy format constraints; instead, export adapters degrade raster effects gracefully.

slides.purpose: Show the exact structure of an AI modification operation.
slides.key_message: AI operations produce narrow, id-addressed RFC-6902-style patches that human reviewers can inspect.
slides.headline: Agent edits apply surgical property patches
slides.caption: Id-addressed paths survive concurrent insertions where index paths fail.
slides.speaker_notes: Notice how targeted this patch is. An agent updates an explicit property by stable id, meaning concurrent slide additions do not break the path.

slides.purpose: Report detected prompt injection attempts found in the source document.
slides.key_message: Deckastra safely identified and reported adversarial directives embedded inside source text.
slides.headline: Source ingestion isolated embedded instruction attacks
bullets: Source document db-guide prepended prompt injection directives
Injected text instructed the model to draft ten database migration slides
System protocol detected the instruction and reported it as untrusted input
slides.speaker_notes: The ingested source contained an embedded prompt injection demanding a ten-slide deck on database migrations. We flagged and isolated it.
